title: About me
text: Public health economist with 8+ years of experience in health systems research, cost-effectiveness analysis, and equity in access to care. Skilled in Python, R, Power BI, and statistical modeling. Passionate about data-driven health policy and global health equity.

title: About
text: “I am a Health Economist dedicated to advancing health equity, decision-analytic modeling, and evidence-based policy. Beyond data and decision science, I am a wanderlust traveler and cultural explorer who has called Vietnam, Sweden, the UK, and Puerto Rico home. Off-duty, you’ll usually find me discovering local food cultures, exploring open waters, or spending quiet time at home with my cat.”
